title: War of the Gods
body:
IUIC in the ClassRoom · 2026-01-17

Opens [Deut 10](/bible/deuteronomy/10) · [Isa 45](/bible/isaiah/45) · [Ps 46](/bible/psalms/46) · [Ps 144](/bible/psalms/144) · [Judg 3](/bible/judges/3) · [Josh 8](/bible/joshua/8) · [Col 1](/bible/colossians/1) · [2 Cor 10](/bible/2-corinthians/10) · [Eph 6](/bible/ephesians/6) · [Rom 1](/bible/romans/1) · [Wis 14](/bible/wisdom-of-solomon/14) · [Sir 39](/bible/sirach/39) · [Obad 1](/bible/obadiah/1) · [Ezek 28](/bible/ezekiel/28) · [Gen 4](/bible/genesis/4) · [Isa 14](/bible/isaiah/14) · and 4 more below
## Introduction *[[7:43](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UBcXHIgpVok&t=463s)]* The class answers those who see a war of the gods. The God of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob is God of gods, a man of war who creates peace and evil, and who teaches his soldiers to war. He left the nations in Canaan so each generation of Israel would learn war, and he gave Joshua a strategy at Ai that won only through obedience. Christ created the principalities and powers Israel wrestles against. The real war is spiritual: against the image of a corruptible man and the stories built around it, and against Edom, who says 'I am a god' and trusts in the smith and the waster God created. Christ will return with his troops and rebuke the wicked inventions of the nations. ## In The News - *[[1:36:14](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UBcXHIgpVok&t=5774s)]* **A narrated account of how a 21st-century combat system tracked and destroyed older fighter jets before they reached altitude.** — Lucifer weakened the nations through war. The same pride that trusts in such weapons will bring him down. - *[[1:41:45](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UBcXHIgpVok&t=6105s)]* **Trump announces that US Space Command headquarters will move to Huntsville, Alabama, and says to call it Rocket City.** — Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, is building its weaponry. God created the smith and the waster. - *[[1:45:06](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UBcXHIgpVok&t=6306s)]* **An author explains DARPA, the Pentagon agency that plans weapons twenty years ahead, and a Venezuelan soldier describes a sonic weapon that left troops incapacitated.** — Who is able to make war with the beast? That is why Israel's war is not against flesh and blood. - *[[1:49:04](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UBcXHIgpVok&t=6544s)]* **The Secretary of Defense tells Trump the department has won no major war since it was renamed from the Department of War, so the name must return.** — They understand the power of a name. Israel should value its own name as much. - *[[1:55:36](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UBcXHIgpVok&t=6936s)]* **A report on an image portraying Donald Trump as a messiah figure.** — They worship the beast and the images of corruptible men. Every one of their idols is a Caesar Borgia. ## Scriptures Opened **[Deuteronomy 10:17](/bible/deuteronomy/10#v17)** *[[10:07](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UBcXHIgpVok&t=607s)]* > [17](/bible/deuteronomy/10#v17) For the Lord your God is God of gods, and Lord of lords, a great God, a mighty, and a terrible, which regardeth not persons, nor taketh reward: - The Lord your God is God of gods and Lord of lords, a great God, mighty and terrible, which regardeth not persons nor taketh reward. - When judgment is set, it goes to its appointed place regardless of status or wealth. **[Isaiah 45:4](/bible/isaiah/45#v4)** *[[12:57](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UBcXHIgpVok&t=777s)]* > [4](/bible/isaiah/45#v4) For Jacob my servant’s sake, and Israel mine elect, I have even called thee by thy name: I have surnamed thee, though thou hast not known me. - I am the Lord and there is none else; I girded thee though thou hast not known me. - I form the light and create darkness; I make peace and create evil; I the Lord do all these things. Precepts: - **[Exodus 15:3](/bible/exodus/15#v3)** > [3](/bible/exodus/15#v3) The Lord is a man of war: the Lord is his name. The Lord is a man of war. **[Psalms 46:7](/bible/psalms/46#v7)** *[[15:52](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UBcXHIgpVok&t=952s)]* > [7](/bible/psalms/46#v7) The Lord of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah. - The God of Jacob is our refuge. Come, behold the desolations he hath made in the earth. - He maketh wars to cease, breaketh the bow and cutteth the spear. The failure of a missile shield is his work, not a glitch. **[Psalms 144:1](/bible/psalms/144#v1)** *[[19:40](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UBcXHIgpVok&t=1180s)]* > [1](/bible/psalms/144#v1) Blessed be the Lord my strength, which teacheth my hands to war, and my fingers to fight: - Blessed be the Lord my strength, which teacheth my hands to war and my fingers to fight. He handpicked every Israelite to be a soldier. Precepts: - **[2 Timothy 2:3](/bible/2-timothy/2#v3)** > [3](/bible/2-timothy/2#v3) Thou therefore endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ. Endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ. **[Judges 3:1](/bible/judges/3#v1)** *[[21:36](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UBcXHIgpVok&t=1296s)]* > [1](/bible/judges/3#v1) Now these are the nations which the Lord left, to prove Israel by them, even as many of Israel as had not known all the wars of Canaan; - The Lord left nations in Canaan to prove Israel and to teach war to the generations that had not known it. - Everything is a teachable moment, even another's correction. Subdue yourself before you try to lead your house or the congregation. **[Joshua 8:1](/bible/joshua/8#v1)** *[[25:04](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UBcXHIgpVok&t=1504s)]* > [1](/bible/joshua/8#v1) And the Lord said unto Joshua, Fear not, neither be thou dismayed: take all the people of war with thee, and arise, go up to Ai: see, I have given into thy hand the king of Ai, and his people, and his city, and his land: - God told Joshua he had already given him Ai, yet commanded an ambush behind the city. The victory is ordained, but it must be won God's way. - Israel fled as commanded, the men of Ai left their city open, and the smoke of the city rose behind them. Victory came through obedience. **[Colossians 1:15](/bible/colossians/1#v15)** *[[38:30](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UBcXHIgpVok&t=2310s)]* > [15](/bible/colossians/1#v15) Who is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of every creature: - Christ is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of every creature. All things, thrones, dominions, principalities and powers, were created by him and for him. - The nations are his sword to whip Israel back to repentance. Precepts: - **[Daniel 4:17](/bible/daniel/4#v17)** > [17](/bible/daniel/4#v17) This matter is by the decree of the watchers, and the demand by the word of the holy ones: to the intent that the living may know that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men, and giveth it to whomsoever he will, and setteth up over it the basest of men. The most High ruleth in the kingdom of men and setteth up over it the basest of men. **[2 Corinthians 10:3](/bible/2-corinthians/10#v3)** *[[43:04](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UBcXHIgpVok&t=2584s)]* > [3](/bible/2-corinthians/10#v3) For though we walk in the flesh, we do not war after the flesh: - Though we walk in the flesh, we do not war after the flesh; the weapons are mighty through God, casting down imaginations and bringing every thought into captivity to Christ. - The spiritual lesson of Joshua is obedience. Leaving the body to 'take a break' is taking a break from the Lord. **[Ephesians 6:12](/bible/ephesians/6#v12)** *[[45:39](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UBcXHIgpVok&t=2739s)]* > [12](/bible/ephesians/6#v12) For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places. - We wrestle not against flesh and blood but against principalities, powers and spiritual wickedness in high places. Christ created both sides of the fight. - The fleshly war belongs to the nations; the Lord taught Israel to war with the word. **[Romans 1:25](/bible/romans/1#v25)** *[[51:30](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UBcXHIgpVok&t=3090s)]* > [25](/bible/romans/1#v25) Who changed the truth of God into a lie, and worshipped and served the creature more than the Creator, who is blessed for ever. Amen. - They changed the truth of God into a lie and worshipped the creature more than the Creator. His eternal power is clearly seen in what is made, so there is no excuse. - Professing themselves wise, they changed the glory of the incorruptible God into an image made like corruptible man. **[Wisdom of Solomon 14:8](/bible/wisdom-of-solomon/14#v8)** *[[1:00:43](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UBcXHIgpVok&t=3643s)]* > [8](/bible/wisdom-of-solomon/14#v8) But that which is made with hands is cursed, as well it, as he that made it: he, because he made it; and it, because, being corruptible, it was called god. - That which is made with hands is cursed, as well it as he that made it. Precepts: - **[Romans 9:20](/bible/romans/9#v20)** > [20](/bible/romans/9#v20) Nay but, O man, who art thou that repliest against God? Shall the thing formed say to him that formed it, Why hast thou made me thus? Shall the thing formed say to him that formed it, Why hast thou made me thus? Esau is a vessel of wrath fitted to destruction. **[Wisdom of Solomon 14:15](/bible/wisdom-of-solomon/14#v15)** *[[1:08:49](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UBcXHIgpVok&t=4129s)]* > [15](/bible/wisdom-of-solomon/14#v15) For a father afflicted with untimely mourning, when he hath made an image of his child soon taken away, now honoured him as a god, which was then a dead man, and delivered to those that were under him ceremonies and sacrifices. - A father made an image of his dead child and honoured him as a god; the ungodly custom grew strong and was kept as a law. - Craftsmen made the image finer and added stories to it, so the multitude took a dead man for a god. That is the image of Caesar Borgia sold as Jesus, and this was an occasion to deceive the world. **[Sirach 39:1](/bible/sirach/39#v1)** *[[1:23:35](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UBcXHIgpVok&t=5015s)]* > [1](/bible/sirach/39#v1) But he that giveth his mind to the law of the most High, and is occupied in the meditation thereof, will seek out the wisdom of all the ancient, and be occupied in prophecies. - He that giveth his mind to the law of the Most High and is occupied in its meditation escapes the great war of ignorance. Seek the wisdom of those long in the truth. **[Obadiah 1:1](/bible/obadiah/1#v1)** *[[1:25:25](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UBcXHIgpVok&t=5125s)]* > [1](/bible/obadiah/1#v1) The vision of Obadiah. Thus saith the Lord God concerning Edom; We have heard a rumour from the Lord, and an ambassador is sent among the heathen, Arise ye, and let us rise up against her in battle. - Edom is made small among the heathen and greatly despised. The pride of his heart has deceived him into thinking he is the wisest and most civilized of the earth. Precepts: - **[Obadiah 1:3](/bible/obadiah/1#v3)** > [3](/bible/obadiah/1#v3) The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee, thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high; that saith in his heart, Who shall bring me down to the ground? The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee, that saith, Who shall bring me down? **[Ezekiel 28:1](/bible/ezekiel/28#v1)** *[[1:28:21](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UBcXHIgpVok&t=5301s)]* > [1](/bible/ezekiel/28#v1) The word of the Lord came again unto me, saying, - Thou hast said, I am a God; yet thou art a man, and not God. There is no secret they can hide. - Because thine heart is lifted up because of thy riches, I will bring strangers upon thee. **[Genesis 4:22](/bible/genesis/4#v22)** *[[1:31:10](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UBcXHIgpVok&t=5470s)]* > [22](/bible/genesis/4#v22) And Zillah, she also bare Tubal–cain, an instructer of every artificer in brass and iron: and the sister of Tubal–cain was Naamah. - Tubal-cain worked brass and iron, and Lamech boasted of slaying a man. Weaponry came through Cain's line to Esau, who lives by the sword and breaks his brother's yoke. Precepts: - **[Genesis 27:40](/bible/genesis/27#v40)** > [40](/bible/genesis/27#v40) And by thy sword shalt thou live, and shalt serve thy brother; and it shall come to pass when thou shalt have the dominion, that thou shalt break his yoke from off thy neck. By thy sword shalt thou live; thou shalt break his yoke from off thy neck. - **[Isaiah 54:16](/bible/isaiah/54#v16)** > [16](/bible/isaiah/54#v16) Behold, I have created the smith that bloweth the coals in the fire, and that bringeth forth an instrument for his work; and I have created the waster to destroy. I have created the smith, and I have created the waster to destroy. **[Isaiah 14:12](/bible/isaiah/14#v12)** *[[1:35:08](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UBcXHIgpVok&t=5708s)]* > [12](/bible/isaiah/14#v12) How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning! how art thou cut down to the ground, which didst weaken the nations! - How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, which didst weaken the nations. The king of Babylon smote the people with a continual stroke. - When he falls, the whole earth is at rest and breaks forth into singing. Precepts: - **[Isaiah 13:19](/bible/isaiah/13#v19)** > [19](/bible/isaiah/13#v19) And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beauty of the Chaldees’ excellency, shall be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah. Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, shall be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah. **[Revelation 13:3](/bible/revelation/13#v3)** *[[1:43:00](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UBcXHIgpVok&t=6180s)]* > [3](/bible/revelation/13#v3) And I saw one of his heads as it were wounded to death; and his deadly wound was healed: and all the world wondered after the beast. - All the world wondered after the beast and worshipped the dragon which gave him power, saying, who is able to make war with him? - It was given him to make war with the saints and overcome them; the nations worship the white man even in congregations where everyone looks like them. Precepts: - **[Isaiah 47:8](/bible/isaiah/47#v8)** > [8](/bible/isaiah/47#v8) Therefore hear now this, thou that art given to pleasures, that dwellest carelessly, that sayest in thine heart, I am, and none else beside me; I shall not sit as a widow, neither shall I know the loss of children: Thou that art given to pleasures, that sayest in thine heart, I am, and none else beside me. - **[Revelation 13:8](/bible/revelation/13#v8)** > [8](/bible/revelation/13#v8) And all that dwell upon the earth shall worship him, whose names are not written in the book of life of the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world. All that dwell upon the earth shall worship him, whose names are not written in the book of life. **[Isaiah 19:2](/bible/isaiah/19#v2)** *[[1:56:42](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UBcXHIgpVok&t=7002s)]* > [2](/bible/isaiah/19#v2) And I will set the Egyptians against the Egyptians: and they shall fight every one against his brother, and every one against his neighbour; city against city, and kingdom against kingdom. - I will set the Egyptians against the Egyptians, city against city and kingdom against kingdom; the spirit of Egypt shall fail. - The Lord hath mingled a perverse spirit in the midst thereof. Egypt is spiritually America. Precepts: - **[Isaiah 31:3](/bible/isaiah/31#v3)** > [3](/bible/isaiah/31#v3) Now the Egyptians are men, and not God; and their horses flesh, and not spirit. When the Lord shall stretch out his hand, both he that helpeth shall fall, and he that is holpen shall fall down, and they all shall fail together. The Egyptians are men, and not God; and their horses flesh, and not spirit. - **[Revelation 11:8](/bible/revelation/11#v8)** > [8](/bible/revelation/11#v8) And their dead bodies shall lie in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt, where also our Lord was crucified. The great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt. **[Habakkuk 3:13](/bible/habakkuk/3#v13)** *[[2:00:30](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UBcXHIgpVok&t=7230s)]* > [13](/bible/habakkuk/3#v13) Thou wentest forth for the salvation of thy people, even for salvation with thine anointed; thou woundedst the head out of the house of the wicked, by discovering the foundation unto the neck. Selah. - Thou wentest forth for the salvation of thy people, even with thine anointed. Christ returns to invade them with his troops. **[Wisdom of Solomon 5:15](/bible/wisdom-of-solomon/5#v15)** *[[2:03:29](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UBcXHIgpVok&t=7409s)]* > [15](/bible/wisdom-of-solomon/5#v15) But the righteous live for evermore; their reward also is with the Lord, and the care of them is with the most High. - The righteous live for evermore; the Lord shall protect them with his arm and make the creature his weapon for revenge of his enemies. - When city fights city and realm fights realm, the Son shall be declared and rebuke the wicked inventions of the nations. Precepts: - **[2 Esdras 13:31](/bible/2-esdras/13#v31)** > [31](/bible/2-esdras/13#v31) And one shall undertake to fight against another, one city against another, one place against another, one people against another, and one realm against another. One city against another, one people against another; and then shall my Son be declared. ## Class Questions - **Why did God leave nations in Canaan?** To prove Israel and teach war to the generations that had not known it (Judges 3:1–2). - **What does the battle of Ai teach?** The victory was already given, but it came only by following God's strategy exactly. Obedience is the spiritual weapon. - **Who created the principalities and powers Israel wrestles against?** Christ, by whom all things were created, visible and invisible (Colossians 1:16). The nations are his sword. - **How did the image of a man become a god?** Wisdom of Solomon 14 describes an image honoured as a god, made finer by craftsmen and backed by stories until the multitude worshipped a dead man. - **What will Christ do to the nations' weapons?** He will rebuke their wicked inventions and destroy them without labour by the law (2 Esdras 13). ## In Closing *[[2:06:23](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UBcXHIgpVok&t=7583s)]* Christ is coming with his troops to rebuke the wicked inventions of the nations. Give yourself to the law, obey God's strategy, and stay strong in the war of the spirit. --- [Class Notes Index](/classes) · [Watch the full session on YouTube ↗](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UBcXHIgpVok)
